title: Mariana Minerals, which builds and operates mines using its MarianaOS software platform, raised a $310M Series B, bringing its total funding to $400M (Allie Garfinkle/Fortune)
summary: Allie Garfinkle / Fortune: Mariana Minerals, which builds and operates mines using its MarianaOS software platform, raised a $310M Series B, bringing its total funding to $400M — The last century was fueled by oil and gas. Turner Caldwell is betting the next century runs on metals.
